text:
maya: Huge shoutout to devon and the infra crew for squashing that noisy alert right before the customer demo. You all saved my morning :raised_hands:
devon: glad it helped! spotted the autoscaler throttle spike and pushed a quick cooldown tweak.
alexa: :tada: love this. devon + infra deserve stickers and caffeine. who’s up for donuts tomorrow? (poll)
jamie: I’m in for donuts. also +1 to sending this to #all-hands as a quick kudos.
nate: wow — nice catch. devon, can you drop the PR link?
devon: PR: https://git.internal/r/1234 (small change to scale cooldown)
maya: adding :sparkles: to the thread — thanks!! :heart:
ops-bot: Reminder: free coffee in the kitchen until 3pm today ☕️
alexa: also can we get a sticker pack for infra heroes? I’m happy to order.
jamie: +1 on sticker pack. maybe a "Service Whisperer" edition :smile:
nate: nominate devon for this week’s kudos board? @people-ops
maya: done — pinged @people-ops and left a tiny note. everyone, thanks again!
devon: thanks team, made my day. :grin:
